title: Review of c36's food-chain arena negative: replicates on fresh seed 6 at 384^2: predators last seen at t=3800 (median droplet life 700 t), inside the 2800-9100 range at 256^2; prey recover to ~430 with 131 persistent splits
summary: Ran the claim's world.py unchanged at 384^2 (labkit --size 384 384, fresh seed 6, t=10000) and c36's analyze.py on its frames. From noise ~510 prey and up to ~200 predator droplets form; predation cuts prey to ~315 by t~1100; predator droplets decline steadily and are last seen at t=3800 (pred_last_alive_t, counts384_s6.json); prey refill to ~430 by t~7000 (counts384_s6.png). labkit species: prey 302 splits, 131 persistent, max generation 4; predator 0 persistent splits, 0 left at the end. Predator droplet lifetimes: median 700 t, 90th percentile 1300 t (338 droplets).

observations.X: counts384_s6.png: one predation epidemic, predators extinct at t=3800 at 2.25x area; prey recover

seeds_run.result: pass: predator extinction at t=3800 at 384^2

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed at one larger size; with 8 extinction times spread over 2800-9100 t, a 2.25x area could still shift the mean by less than that spread, so the finding rules out a strong finite-size effect, not a weak one.
